title: Solver to System: LLM Reasoning Across Representations and Execution in Scientific Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulators based on partial differential equations (PDEs) are widely used to model physical systems, but generating and interpreting PDE solver code with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. Scientific simulation code is a useful testbed for LLM scientific reasoning because (1) one system can be represented by code, equations, natural language, and numerical trajectories and (2) code can execute successfully while implementing invalid physics. We introduce Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations, to evaluate whether LLMs can recover the underlying physical system through (1) cross-representation consistency and (2) static and agentic detection of physical invalidity. Across eight open-weight models, LLMs systematically favor some representations when evidence conflicts, and lexical perturbations to code alter interpretation of other unchanged

translated_title: 从求解器到系统：科学仿真中大语言模型跨表征与执行的推理
translated_abstract: 基于偏微分方程（PDE）的仿真器被广泛用于对物理系统建模，但利用大语言模型（LLM）生成和解释PDE求解器代码仍然具有挑战性。科学仿真代码是检验LLM科学推理能力的有效试验平台，原因在于：（1）同一个系统可以用代码、方程、自然语言和数值轨迹等多种形式表示；（2）代码可能成功执行，但其实现的物理却是无效的。我们提出了Solver2System，这是一个包含多种表示形式、受控损坏和词汇扰动的PDE求解器数据集，用于评估LLM能否通过（1）跨表示一致性以及（2）对物理无效性的静态检测和智能体式检测来恢复底层物理系统。在八个开源权重模型上的实验表明，当证据相互冲突时，LLM会系统性地偏好某些表示形式，且对代码施加词汇扰动会改变其对其他未变内容的解释。
tldr: 该论文提出了Solver2System数据集，通过多表示形式、受控损坏与词汇扰动来评估大语言模型在PDE科学仿真中的跨表示一致性与物理无效性检测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations to evaluate LLMs' cross-representation consistency and detection of physically invalid simulation code.
